title: DTN HBH parse: walk IPv6 HBH options TLVs in parse_ipv6_dispatch, extract S-flag + Type 0x03 expiry
description: Child of b7z9.8.2 (smallest first). lichen/subsys/lichen/routing/router.c parse_ipv6_dispatch() validates the extension chain but never walks the options TLVs inside the HBH header. Add TLV walking (RFC 8200 option format: type high-bits action/1B len) extracting: (a) DTN S-flag option per spec 05-routing.md 9.8 (1-byte flags: S bit | reserved, reject nonzero reserved?), (b) App Data Type 0x03 absolute expiry (4B UTC big-endian). Expose parsed values in struct ipv6_dispatch_view (dtn_s_requested, dtn_expiry_unix). Validate: HBH must appear only right after fixed header (already enforced), option lengths within header bounds, unknown option action bits honored (skip/reject per RFC). Behavior-neutral until .2.2 wires the routing decision - this lands parse+validation+view only, with focused ztest asserts in tests/routing_dispatch.
